Individual attribution requires a separately sourced item in this profile.

The dated designation announcement and the living sanctions list are two Republic of Korea Ministry of Foreign Affairs publications in one official source family; retain both for complementary claim-level support and treat them as one source family. The living-list citation establishes list presence and naming as accessed; current activity, location, role, and operational control require newer evidence.
The direct asset is reference metadata only; caching requires approval.

The Korean source's explicit December 11 U.S. indictment reference strongly links this row to the DOJ Kim Ryu Song record, while research/raw/international.json contains another Kim Ryu Song with a different affiliation. Keep same-name records separate pending claim-level reconciliation.

The ROK announcement explicitly identifies 김류성 by reference to the December 2024 U.S. indictment, supporting a claim-scoped crosswalk to the E.D. Mo. defendant. MSMT Annex 10 identifies a separate same-name person, while Umnal, Chinyong, and Russia claims remain with their source records.
This record preserves the official source's stated role in an overseas IT delegation or related entity. Personal software-development work requires a separate source finding.
Wanted and charged status records the case posture; guilt remains unadjudicated.
